integrity: The homotopy claim is supported by an explicit finite discrete-Morse matching whose full oriented Hasse diagram is replayed from the embedded verifier; a separate mod-2 chain computation cross-checks the resulting homology.
scientific_limitations: The result is restricted to the eight-vertex Möbius ladder \(M_8\) and the total \(3\)-cut complex.
No family-level periodicity, shellability, or equivariant statement is asserted.
title: The total \(3\)-cut complex of the Wagner graph is a wedge of three \(2\)-spheres
